profile.summary: Ravi Kumar Distilleries Limited manufactures, sells, and trades Indian made foreign liquors in India. The company manufactures and trades whisky, brandy, rum, gin, and vodka under the Capricorn, Jean Brothers, Black Berry, 2Barrels, Green Magic, Chevalier, and Once More brands.
